overloadMerges.note: menuItem's -1 sentinel (last item added) and process's omission behavior are documented in prose but weren't captured as sentinelValues/description by the mechanical draft.

params.name: menu
params.description: Menu number, or a MenuRef (reference) created with Create menu.

sentinelValues.meaning: the last item added to menu

params.name: process
params.description: If omitted, applies to the menu bar of the current process. Ignored if menu is a MenuRef.

constraints: If the designated menu item is itself a menu managed by reference (e.g. created with Create menu), only that instance in menu is removed; the referenced submenu itself continues to exist in memory until explicitly released with RELEASE MENU.
Also works with a menu bar created with Create menu and installed with SET MENU BAR.
